steps.note: the API built this case's state
Configure the event as an RFQ, which is the source stage for conversion.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product needed for the vendor bid.
Invite the vendor who will submit the edge-case bid.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the RFQ pricing sheet as the vendor.
Submit the price with the required trailing space.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the bid.
Return to the buyer's event page for conversion.
Use the RFQ project action to convert the active RFQ and carry its bid into the auction.
Confirm conversion did not produce an error.
Open the buyer's comparison grid containing the converted auction bid.
Verify the copied bid is displayed as numeric price 100, with the trailing space trimmed.
Confirm the converted auction screen shows no error.
